note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive (Hutong NYC explicitly so), and August targets step up again, so weekly and YTD variances read heavily negative by design. The portfolio booked 452 GA4 bookings against a 1,101 blended weekly target, down 12.4 percent week on week and 29.8 percent below last year. Hutong Miami was the only venue up week on week (+27.3 percent, on users +11.3 percent). Aqua NYC fell to 201 (-22.4% WoW) even though its users are 17.6 percent ahead of last year, so its gap is conversion rather than traffic. All three venues are below YTD target: Aqua NYC 8,576 against 14,969, Hutong NYC 5,399 against 14,565, Hutong Miami 3,217 against 4,602. Read this with the covers report: both US Hutongs moved their Google Reserve booking provider to OpenTable in March, so part of the year on year decline in website bookings is a routing change rather than lost demand. Hutong Miami's monthly GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan (x 6738/4756).
